[[File:Marcin Solonczak Worlds 2002.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Marcin Solonczak at the 2002 Lord of the Rings TCG World Championship.]]
'''Marcin Solonczak''' won the 2002 DGMA European Continental Championship of [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]] in Amsterdam.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="dgma68" /> He was the Sullust Regional qualifier at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], from Krakow, Poland.<ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>
